spokenDescription.base: A mossy clearing wrapped in tall whispering trees. Fireflies drift like tiny lanterns.

byCompanion.ember: A mossy clearing full of wonderful smells — moss, mushrooms, and maybe... biscuits? Fireflies drift like tiny lanterns.
byCompanion.petal: A mossy clearing where the breeze spirals up and up. From above, the fireflies look like a river of stars.
byCompanion.clover: A soft, mossy clearing. So many gentle sounds live here — listen, you can hear the trees breathing.

lockedExplanation.base: The acorn is still asleep, high in the branches. If we sing the oak's waking song, it will hand it down to us.

byCompanion.ember: The acorn is snoozing up in the branches — even my nose can't reach that high! Let's sing the oak's waking song. Yip!
byCompanion.petal: The acorn is dreaming up in the branches... I flew past it! Sing the oak's waking song and it will drift down to us.
byCompanion.clover: Shh... the acorn is sleeping up in the branches. If we sing the waking song very nicely, the oak will hand it down.

lockedExplanation.base: We can go to the castle someday — but the bridge is still broken.

byCompanion.ember: The castle? Ooh, I can smell its banners from here! But the bridge is still broken. One day, yip!
byCompanion.petal: The castle towers look lovely from up high... but the bridge is still broken, so our feet must wait.
byCompanion.clover: I can hear the castle flags flapping, far away... but the bridge is still broken. Someday soon.

lockedExplanation.base: Behind that waterfall I can hear deep echoes... but the oak says we need the glowing acorn first.

byCompanion.ember: There's a cave behind the waterfall — I can smell cool stone! But the oak says: acorn first, adventure second. Yip!
byCompanion.petal: Behind the falling water, the dark sings back... the oak says the glowing acorn must light our way first.
byCompanion.clover: I hear a big, deep echo behind the waterfall... the oak whispered that we need the glowing acorn before we go in.

entities.name: buried honey biscuit

senseLine.base: My nose found something buried near the big root!

byCompanion.ember: Sniff sniff — YIP! Something delicious is buried near the big root. Foxes first!

entities.hiddenTease: Something is tucked away near the big root, but I can't tell what it is.

entities.name: songbird nest

senseLine.base: I can see a cozy nest up in the branches — with three sleepy chicks inside!

byCompanion.petal: Ooh... up in the branches, a cozy nest with three sleepy chicks. The sky always knows!

entities.hiddenTease: Something rustles way up in the branches, but it's too high for me to tell.

entities.name: hidden stream

senseLine.base: My ears hear water murmuring under the ground — a secret stream!

byCompanion.clover: Oh my... do you feel that? Water is whispering under the ground. A secret stream, just for us.

entities.hiddenTease: I keep feeling like something is murmuring nearby, but it's too quiet for me.

spokenDescription.base: A vast cave where crystals glow like frozen starlight. Every sound comes back to say hello twice.

byCompanion.ember: A huge, cool cave! It smells like rain and old stone, and the crystals glow like frozen starlight. Hello-hello! Hear that? The cave says everything twice.
byCompanion.petal: Ooh... a cave of frozen starlight. The crystals hum, and every sound floats up and up and comes back twice as soft.
byCompanion.clover: A great big quiet... full of tiny sounds. The crystals are humming, and the cave whispers everything back twice. I love it here.

lockedExplanation.base: The moonstone sleeps inside the big crystal. If we sing the crystal's echo song, it will open like a flower.

byCompanion.ember: The moonstone is tucked inside the big crystal — even my nose can't dig through crystal! Let's sing its echo song. Yip!
byCompanion.petal: The moonstone dreams inside the crystal... sing the echo song, and it will open like a flower made of light.
byCompanion.clover: Shh... the moonstone is sleeping inside the crystal. If we sing its echo song very gently, it will open up.

entities.name: glow mushrooms

senseLine.base: My nose found mushrooms that glow in the dark — they smell like warm bread!

byCompanion.ember: Sniff sniff — YIP! Glow mushrooms! They smell like warm bread and starlight. Foxes first!

entities.hiddenTease: Something near the cave wall smells faintly sweet, but I can't tell what it is.

entities.name: hidden geode

senseLine.base: Up on the high ledge — a geode full of purple stars!

byCompanion.petal: Ooh... up on the high ledge, a geode blooming with purple stars. The sky always knows — even underground.

entities.hiddenTease: Something glitters way up on the high ledge, but it's too far to see.

entities.name: underground river

senseLine.base: My ears hear a great river sliding under the stone — the cave's own heartbeat!

byCompanion.clover: Oh my... listen. A whole river is sliding under the stone. It's like the cave has a heartbeat, just for us.

entities.hiddenTease: Sometimes the floor seems to murmur down low, but it's too quiet for me.

spokenSummary.base: The old oak lost its glowing acorn. We promised to wake the oak with its favorite song and bring the acorn home.

byCompanion.ember: Yip! The old oak lost its glowing acorn. We promised to sing the oak awake and sniff that acorn home!
byCompanion.petal: The old oak is dreaming about its lost glowing acorn... we promised to wake it gently with its favorite song.
byCompanion.clover: The old oak misses its glowing acorn. We promised — very quietly — to sing it awake and bring the acorn home.

steps.intro: Someone is calling for you in Fox Hollow. Follow the friendly voice!

celebration.base: You found your friend! This is the start of something wonderful.

byCompanion.ember: Yip yip! You found me! This is the start of something wonderful!
byCompanion.petal: Ooh, there you are! Like two clouds finding each other.
byCompanion.clover: Oh my... you found me. I'm so glad it's you.

hintLadder: Listen for the voice that's calling you.
The friendly voice is close. Walk toward it and it will get louder.
Walk straight toward the calling voice, just ahead of you. A few steps and you're there.

steps.intro: Say hello to your new friend!
steps.celebration: A friendship like this only comes along once in a forest.
hintLadder: Your friend is waiting to chat.
Tap your friend to say hello.
Tap the glowing friend right in front of you to start talking.

intro.base: The old oak is the deep creaking sound. Let's go say hello.

byCompanion.ember: The old oak smells like rain and storybooks. Follow the creaking, yip!
byCompanion.petal: The old oak is the tallest dream in this forest. Follow the slow creaking sound.
byCompanion.clover: Hear that slow, deep creaking? That's the old oak breathing. Let's walk to it together.

steps.celebration: You found the old oak! Its branches stretch over you like a roof of stars.
hintLadder: The oak is the slow, creaky sound.
Follow the deep creaking wood — that's the old oak.
Turn until the creaking is straight ahead, then walk. The old oak is waiting.

intro.base: The oak is sleeping. Listen to its waking song, then sing it back!

byCompanion.ember: The oak snores louder than me! Listen to its waking song, then sing it back — yip!
byCompanion.petal: Shh... the oak is dreaming. Listen to its waking song, then sing it back softly.
byCompanion.clover: The oak is deep asleep. Listen very carefully to its song, then we'll sing it back together.

steps.celebration: The old oak stretches its branches awake! Leaves shiver with happiness all around you.
hintLadder: Listen to the notes first, then copy them.
The song climbs from low to high, one note at a time.
Tap the notes in order, low to high, just like the oak sang them. Take your time — the oak loves to listen.

steps.intro: The oak hands down its glowing acorn — it chimes like a tiny bell. Go collect it!

celebration.base: You did it! The glowing acorn is safe, and the whole forest hums a thank-you.

byCompanion.ember: YIP YIP YIP! The glowing acorn is ours — I mean, the oak's! The whole forest is cheering for you!
byCompanion.petal: Ooh... the acorn glows like a baby star. The whole forest hums a thank-you, one wingbeat at a time.
byCompanion.clover: You did it... you really did it. Can you hear the whole forest humming thank-you? That's for you.

hintLadder: Follow the tiny chime.
The chiming acorn is very close to the oak's roots.
The acorn is right beside the oak, one step away. Follow the silver chime.

quests.title: The Buried Biscuit
quests.spokenSummary: My nose found a honey biscuit buried near the big root. A hero's snack for a hero's day!

steps.intro: Follow my sniffing — the biscuit is buried near the big root!
steps.celebration: A honey biscuit! Half for you, half for me. Okay... maybe a bit more than half for me. Yip!
hintLadder: Follow my sniffing sounds.
The big root is ahead on your right, a short walk away.
Walk ahead and right until you hear me digging — the biscuit is right there.

quests.title: Three Sleepy Chicks
quests.spokenSummary: I spotted a nest up in the branches with three sleepy chicks. Let's go stand beneath it and listen to them dream.

steps.intro: The nest is up high, ahead on your right. Stand beneath it, very gently.
steps.celebration: Tiny chirps, like little bells... they're dreaming about flying. Just like I dream about you, friend.
hintLadder: Listen up high for tiny chirps.
Walk ahead and to your right until the sleepy chirps are right above you.
Stand right under the branches ahead-right — when the chirps are overhead, you're there.

quests.title: The Secret Stream
quests.spokenSummary: My ears found a secret stream whispering under the ground. Want to go listen to it with me?

steps.intro: The secret stream is behind us, down low. Walk softly and listen.
steps.celebration: There... water singing under the earth. Nobody else in the whole forest knows this song. Just us.
hintLadder: Turn around and listen for the tiniest trickle.
The stream whispers behind you, to the left, down low.
Turn all the way around and walk — when the trickle is loudest, kneel down. That's our stream.

spokenSummary.base: The old oak told us a secret: behind the waterfall, the Crystal Caves are waiting. Find the singing crystal, wake it with its echo song, and bring home the moonstone to mend the broken bridge.

byCompanion.ember: Yip! The oak told us a secret — a whole cave behind the waterfall! We'll sniff out the singing crystal, sing its echo song, and carry home the moonstone to fix the broken bridge!
byCompanion.petal: The oak whispered us a secret... behind the waterfall, the Crystal Caves are dreaming. We'll wake the singing crystal with its echo song and float the moonstone home to mend the bridge.
byCompanion.clover: The oak told us, very quietly... the Crystal Caves are behind the waterfall. We'll listen for the singing crystal, sing its echo song together, and bring the moonstone home to mend the bridge.

intro.base: Follow the sound of falling water — the cave door is behind the waterfall.

byCompanion.ember: Follow the splashy water sound! The cave door hides behind the waterfall — foxes first, yip!
byCompanion.petal: Drift toward the falling water... the cave door hides behind its silver curtain.
byCompanion.clover: Listen for the falling water... the cave door is hiding right behind it. We'll go together.

steps.celebration: The waterfall parts like a curtain — cool air and crystal light spill out!
hintLadder: Listen for the rushing waterfall.
The waterfall is ahead on your left. Walk toward the falling water.
Turn until the waterfall sound is straight ahead, then walk to it. Then go through the waterfall cave.

intro.base: Deep in the cave, the singing crystal hums its echo song. Listen carefully — cave songs are longer than forest songs!

byCompanion.ember: Hear that ringing? That's the singing crystal! Cave songs are longer than forest songs — ears up, yip!
byCompanion.petal: The singing crystal is humming, soft as starlight... cave songs are longer than forest songs, so listen with your whole heart.
byCompanion.clover: The singing crystal is humming for us... cave songs are longer than forest songs. We'll listen twice if we need to.

steps.celebration: The whole cave rings like a bell choir! The big crystal opens like a flower of light.
hintLadder: Walk to the ringing crystal first, then listen to its song.
The crystal's song climbs up like stairs. Listen, then copy it one note at a time.
Stand by the crystal, tap 'Hear it again', and copy the notes from low to high. Take all the time you want.

steps.intro: Inside the open crystal, the moonstone shimmers. Follow its silvery sound!

celebration.base: The moonstone is yours! It glows warm in your hands, like a tiny piece of the moon that wanted a friend.

byCompanion.ember: YIP! The moonstone! It's warm like a sunbeam and it picked YOU to carry it home!
byCompanion.petal: Ooh... the moonstone. A tiny piece of the moon that wanted a friend. And it chose you.
byCompanion.clover: The moonstone... it's humming so happily in your hands. I think it's been waiting for you.

hintLadder: Follow the soft silvery shimmer.
The moonstone is right beside the big crystal, very close.
The moonstone is one step from the singing crystal. Follow the silvery shimmer sound.

steps.intro: Now carry the moonstone back toward the waterfall doorway — its light wants to fix something.

celebration.base: The moonstone blazes like a little moon! Its light pours out of the cave and weaves the broken bridge back together, plank by plank. The way to the castle is open... for next time.

byCompanion.ember: Look-look-LOOK! The moonstone light is fixing the bridge — plank by plank by plank! The castle road is open! Next adventure, here we come — YIP!
byCompanion.petal: Ooh... the moonstone light is weaving the bridge back together, like morning weaves the sky. The castle is waiting for us... next time.
byCompanion.clover: Oh my... the light is mending the bridge, so gently. Plank by plank. The castle road is open now. For next time... together.

hintLadder: Head back toward the waterfall sound.
The waterfall doorway is behind you. Turn around and walk toward it.
Turn all the way around and walk toward the waterfall doorway — the moonstone will do the rest.

line.base: There you are! I've been waiting for you. The old oak needs our help — are you ready for an adventure?

byCompanion.ember: There you are! Yip! I smelled you coming from across the hollow — you smell like adventure! The old oak needs our help. Ready?
byCompanion.petal: Ooh, there you are... I watched you walk in from way up high. The old oak needs our help. Shall we have an adventure, you and I?
byCompanion.clover: Oh! There you are... I heard your footsteps from across the hollow. The old oak needs our help. Will you come with me?

line.base: That's the spirit! Stay close to me and follow the sounds — the forest will show us the way.

byCompanion.ember: YIP! That's the spirit! Stick with me, brave one — foxes first, adventure always!
byCompanion.petal: Ooh, how wonderful! Then let's drift toward the old oak — one wingbeat at a time.
byCompanion.clover: Really? You're so brave... okay! I'll stay right beside you the whole way.

line.base: That's okay — being careful is a kind of brave too. We'll go slowly, and I'll stay right beside you.

byCompanion.ember: Hey, that's okay! Even foxes get whisker-wobbles. We'll go slow, and I'll be your nose AND your courage. Yip.
byCompanion.petal: That's alright, little cloud... nervous wings still fly. We'll go gently, you and I.
byCompanion.clover: Me too, actually... but quiet things are brave too. We'll be nervous together — and that's almost the same as brave.

line.base: Mmmrrr... zzz... hm? Oh! A small visitor, and a friend. I am Boulder. I have guarded these crystals for nine hundred years... and napped for eight hundred of them.

choices.text: Shh... sorry for waking you, Mr. Boulder.
Wake up, sleepy rock! It's adventure time!

dialogues.speaker: Boulder
dialogues.line: Such gentle manners... the crystals will like you. Little friend, the singing crystal loves to teach its song to kind visitors. Sing it back, and the moonstone is yours. Now... zzz... mrrr...

dialogues.speaker: Boulder
dialogues.line: Ho ho ho! Adventure time, is it? You remind me of the earthquakes — full of bounce! Very well: the singing crystal will teach you its song. Sing it back, and the moonstone is yours. Wake me when you're famous... zzz...
